title: 第599章 一起睡第598章 又变成傻子了
content_zh:
她小心翼翼地替陈景言褪下那件早已破烂不堪的外衣，动作轻柔得如同对待易碎的珍宝。
随着衣物一件件滑落，那具曾经充满力量与阳刚之气的身躯逐渐显露出来。
依旧是十年前那副健硕的体魄，肌肉线条紧实如铁，胸膛宽阔，腰腹有力。
然而，令人触目惊心的是，这具本该完美无瑕的身体上，却布满了纵横交错、深浅不一的暗红色疤痕。
那些伤痕如同被烈火灼烧过的蜈蚣，狰狞地蜿蜒爬过他的胸腹与后背。
最深的一道自左肩斜斜贯穿至右肋，边缘微微泛白，像是被某种强腐蚀性的酸液反复侵蚀过，留下永久的印记。
“景言，姐姐帮你洗澡。”陈薇薇强压住心头翻涌的情绪，拿起花洒，温热的水流缓缓滑过他厚实的肩背，冲刷掉积年的污垢与尘埃。
她抬手，掌心轻轻按在他坚实的胸肌上，指腹感受到那熟悉的肌肉纹理，却在触及心跳的瞬间猛然顿住——那曾经如战鼓般沉稳有力的心跳，此刻竟微弱得如同风中残烛，时断时续，仿佛随时都会熄灭，沉入永恒的寂静。
尽管她和陈景言早已育有一个十岁的儿子，但整整十年，她再未与任何男人有过亲密接触。
岁月模糊了记忆，她几乎快要忘记男人肌肤的温度，忘记他掌心粗粝的纹路如何温柔地摩挲过自己的后颈，也忘了那种只属于男女之间的、令人心尖发颤的悸动与战栗。
此刻，水珠顺着她的睫毛滑落，滴在锁骨上，温热而湿润。
她分不清那是花洒喷洒的热水，还是自己眼中再也无法抑制的滚烫泪水。
她忽然毫无预兆地扑上前，紧紧抱住陈景言，仿佛要把自己整个人嵌进他的身体里。
她的脸颊深深埋进他汗湿的颈窝，鼻尖紧贴着他温热的皮肤，呼吸急促而颤抖，贪婪地汲取着那久违的气息。
那是混合着铁锈般微腥的汗味与清冽皂角香的味道，是他身上独有的、让她魂牵梦萦的体温。
陈景言站在原地一动不动，任由头顶倾泻而下的热水冲刷着发丝和肩膀，水珠顺着他棱角分明的脸颊滑落。
他浑浊的眼睛怔怔望着前方，渐渐蒙上一层朦胧的水雾，分不清是蒸汽还是别的什么。
良久，他缓缓抬起手，动作笨拙却温柔地轻轻拍了拍陈薇薇的后背，喉咙里发出低沉而憨厚的笑声：“软软……舒服……”
声音沙哑，却带着孩子般的满足。
陈薇薇咬紧下唇，硬生生把即将涌出的哭声咽回喉咙深处，只让一声细微的抽泣从鼻腔溢出。

她吸了吸鼻子，强忍住眼眶里的酸涩，重新拿起沐浴露，挤在掌心搓出细腻的泡沫，然后一点点、极其细致地为他清洗身体。
她的指尖小心翼翼地避开那些横亘在他肩背与手臂上的狰狞疤痕。
那些伤痕如同岁月刻下的烙印，诉说着他失踪多年所经历的苦难。
content_en:
She carefully took off Chen Jingyan's already tattered coat, her movements as gentle as handling a fragile treasure.
As the clothes fell off one by one, the body that was once full of strength and masculinity was gradually revealed.
He still has the strong physique he had ten years ago, with muscles as tight as iron, a broad chest, and a strong waist and abdomen.
However, what is shocking is that this supposedly flawless body is covered with criss-crossing dark red scars of varying shades.
Those scars were like centipedes burned by fire, snaking ferociously across his chest, abdomen and back.
The deepest one ran diagonally from the left shoulder to the right rib. The edge was slightly white, as if it had been repeatedly eroded by some highly corrosive acid, leaving a permanent mark.
"Jing Yan, sister, help you take a bath." Chen Weiwei suppressed the surging emotions in her heart and picked up the shower head. The warm water slowly slid over his thick shoulders and washed away the accumulated dirt and dust.
She raised her hand and pressed her palm gently on his solid chest muscles. She felt the familiar muscle texture on her fingertips, but suddenly stopped when she touched the heartbeat - the heartbeat that was once as steady and powerful as a war drum was now as weak as a candle in the wind, intermittent, as if it would be extinguished at any time and sink into eternal silence.
Although she and Chen Jingyan already had a ten-year-old son, she had never had close contact with any man for ten years.
Time has blurred her memory, and she has almost forgotten the temperature of the man's skin, how the rough lines on his palms gently rubbed the back of her neck, and the heart-shaking throbbing and trembling that only belongs between men and women.
At this moment, water droplets slid down her eyelashes and dripped on her collarbone, warm and moist.
She couldn't tell whether it was the hot water sprayed by the shower head, or the hot tears in her eyes that could no longer be suppressed.
She suddenly rushed forward without warning and hugged Chen Jingyan tightly, as if she wanted to embed her entire body into his body.
Her cheeks were buried deep into his sweaty neck, her nose pressed against his warm skin, her breathing quick and trembling, greedily sucking in the long-lost breath.
It was a mixture of the rusty smell of sweat and the refreshing scent of soap locust. It was his unique body temperature that made her dream.
Chen Jingyan stood motionless, letting the hot water pouring down from his head wash his hair and shoulders, and the water droplets slid down his angular cheeks.
His cloudy eyes stared ahead, gradually becoming covered with a hazy mist, and he couldn't tell whether it was steam or something else.
After a long time, he slowly raised his hand, clumsily but gently patted Chen Weiwei's back, and a low and honest laugh came from his throat: "Soft...comfortable..."
The voice was hoarse, but filled with childlike contentment.
Chen Weiwei bit her lower lip and swallowed the crying that was about to come back deep in her throat, letting only a slight sob escape from her nasal cavity.
She sniffed, suppressing the soreness in her eyes, picked up the shower gel again, squeezed it into her palms to create fine foam, and then washed his body bit by bit, extremely meticulously.
Her fingertips carefully avoided the hideous scars across his shoulders, back and arms.
Those scars are like marks carved by the years, telling the story of the suffering he experienced for many years after missing.
